pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.
   D. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   C. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Use Names of Scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures.
   D. Say Names of Scriptures has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Simple postures? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Simple postures has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Simple postures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Simple postures.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   B. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. A — Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. B — Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
